_comment: Per-kernel byte-traffic manifest for the verify/draft path, main @ 45facc9. Every formula is a LOWER bound on compulsory HBM bytes for that kernel per forward pass, expressed over the shape environment that gen.py builds from the model config.json. Integer division // is exact for all shapes here. 'ctx' is the committed context length. Citations give the code the formula is derived from; checkpoint witnesses are safetensors tensors whose recorded shapes/dtypes pin the byte counts. gen.py cross-checks the formula sums against an independent scan of the safetensors headers and emits both into Rocq, where the equality is re-proved by vm_compute. Each verify phase carries a `witness` selector (layer class + tensor-name regex, or an exact name); gen.py sums the ACTUAL safetensors bytes those selectors match and asserts formula == matched per phase, that the selectors are pairwise disjoint, and that the unmatched residual equals misc_small_bytes. Before 2026-08-10 the only check was misc := lang_bytes - sum(formulas) plus a range assert, which is satisfied identically by construction and lets per-phase errors cancel.

verify_weight_phases.kernel: dense bf16 lm_head GEMM over all k rows (tied embedding matrix, read in full every verify forward)
cite: gemma4.rs:2361,2366 (default path: lm_head.forward_dense(final_norm(hidden)); the int8 variant is DEFAULT-ON since 2026-08-11 via NV_VERIFY_LMHEAD_INT8 (=0 reverts); it measured slower only as v1, which was STAGE-bound at K=5376; the v2 normx_mk + gemv_i8_prenormed_mk kernel gives -0.82 ms/round served with 48/48 argmax agreement)

verify_kv_read.kernel: tree_verify_attn committed-prefix K/V stream (bf16 verify cache at HEAD; NV_GEMMA4_FP8_KV opt-in halves this)
cite: tree_verify_attn.cu:92-108 (per position p in [win_start, nc): one K row and one V row of HD bf16 per kv head)
tree_verify_attn.cu:73-79 (win_start = max(0, qpos-(window-1)); WindowClamp.committed_range_exact proves this equals the attention-set semantics)
gemma4.rs:828 (verify cache is bf16 unless NV_GEMMA4_FP8_KV set)
full layers: K counted once and V not counted (k_eq_v layers share K/V content; unique-byte lower bound)
sliding layers: union over the K tree queries of the clamped ranges covers min(ctx, window-1) positions (query 0 at qpos=nc attends [nc-window+1, nc)); K and V are distinct buffers -> *2
verify_kv_read.note: This is a UNIQUE-BYTE lower bound: each counted byte must cross HBM at least once per forward. The kernel actually re-reads per kv-head-group and per query (diag-budget measured ~20x once-read on the ctx slope), so the true traffic is far above this floor.
